about: The journal's fold (docs/engine.md, "The journal"): events in their wire form, in the order they arrived, folded against this file's invented `plans`. The output is the number of distinct events, the inert ones and why, the events an active undo has taken back (`undone`), and each enrollment's start, end, settled slots in reading order and paused days; `on` asks for the arrangement on those dates. Or the error's kind and message when the journal is refused. Event ids are written so that event 2 follows event 1; the plans' readings are invented, not any plan's schedule.

a copy that differs only in a field the engine does not read is the same event
a double tap: two events, one slot, and one undo leaves it read

two undos of one event are one undo

two enrollments of one plan keep their own slots
slots are listed in reading order, not id order
a calendar slot is an assignment and its date
no enrollment: none, or one that comes later
an unknown plan or version enrolls nothing
a behavior the plan does not permit, or a finish date without one
enrolling again does nothing
an assignment the plan version does not have
the wrong slot
a start moved later keeps the readings made before it
an undo with nothing to take back
after the plan is ended only un-ending it has effect
un-ending a plan
ended again by a redo: what was read meanwhile stays
changes take effect from their dates; the start is not dated
the last change in journal order wins, not the one with the latest date
a change undone
changes that do nothing or are not permitted
a change to a finish date, and its limit from then on
an enrollment toward a finish date
paused days run up to the day of resuming
undoing a resume leaves the pause running
a resume dated on or before its pause pauses no days
resuming toward a new finish date needs a finish-date plan
a return choice must be one for the behavior
